production.note: US model years, from a database (last resort; no manufacturer or magazine page stating US model years was found). First: KBB lists the 2009 trims as 'LP 560-4 Coupe 2D' and 'LP 560-4 Roadster 2D', while the 2008 trims are 'Coupe 2D', 'Superleggera Coupe 2D' and 'Spyder Roadster 2D' (kbb-gallardo-2008). Last: KBB's 2014 Gallardo lists 'LP 560-4 Coupe 2D' (kbb-gallardo-2014); KBB's 2015 Gallardo URL returns the 2014 page, and KBB calls the 2015 Huracán 'the replacement for the popular Gallardo' (kbb-huracan-2015). Evo (2 Apr 2008): 'deliveries start Summer '08' (evo-gallardo-lp560). Includes the restyled LP 560-4 shown at Paris 2012, same designation. The Spyder is a separate record.

body.note: Coupe; the open car is the Gallardo LP 560-4 Spyder (separate record).

configuration.note: V10 per the release; Evo: '90deg V10, mid, longitudinal, 5204cc' (evo-gallardo-lp560)

displacementL.note: 5,204 cc ('The engine has a 5204 cm3 volumetric displacement which, with 8.000 rpm creates the extreme 560 PS (412 kW).')

aspiration.note: Naturally aspirated V10 per the release

drivetrain.note: 'permanent four-wheel drive transmission'; 'four-wheel drive Viscous Traction (VT) system'

transmission.note: 'the exact gate guides of the six-speed gearbox via the short gear stick' or 'the e.gear's paddle-shift system' (e-gear, a single-clutch automated manual on the six-speed gearbox)

powerHp.note: Quote: "The engine has a 5204 cm3 volumetric displacement which, with 8.000 rpm creates the extreme 560 PS (412 kW)." 560 PS x 0.98632 = 552 hp. Evo's spec table agrees: '552bhp @ 8000rpm' (evo-gallardo-lp560). No separate US SAE rating was found, so powerStandard is DIN PS. KBB prints Lamborghini's metric figure as hp; no hp rating from Lamborghini's US arm was found, so the guide's conversion is used.

weightLb.note: DRY weight (no curb weight for the standard car, and no optioned-car curb weight, was found from Lamborghini or a major magazine). Quote: "It weighs in dry at 1410 kilograms – which is, effectively, 20 kilograms less that that of the previous Gallardo." 1,410 x 2.20462 = 3,109 lb. The release does not say whether this is with options.
